comparison.objective: Fill a fuel can only after placing it safely on the ground, then return it; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: PR transports a can and positions a fuel nozzle while observing a grounding rule. Candidate performs recessed-tool manipulation, collar adjustment, locking, and guarded cycling.
comparison.success_condition: PR permanently fails if fuel flows while the can is not safely grounded; full credit follows filling and return. Candidate fails unsafe energized adjustment and requires two bounded impacts. PR lacks a separate spec.
comparison.reason: The shared safe sequencing is generic; fuel-container handling does not test damper adjustment or dynamic stopping behavior.
